**STEP 1 - Scene:** An airline-style tray meal, photographed from above. It includes a pasta course (lasagna-type and tortellini), sliced roast meat, a green salad, fruit, and drinks. I treat everything on the tray as the meal.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** Large plate (~24 cm, area ~450 cm²) for the lasagna, side plate (~20 cm, ~314 cm²) for the tortellini and the meat, and a cereal-sized bowl (~15 cm, ~177 cm²) each for the salad and fruit. The drinks are in glasses and a bottle.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Lasagna in meat sauce, cheese tortellini in red sauce, sliced roast beef, mixed green salad with tomato, fruit salad, a small cup of dressing, orange juice, water, and a milky iced coffee.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Lasagna ~13% of its plate (~60 cm²), tortellini ~30% of its plate (~94 cm²), roast beef ~20% of its plate (~63 cm²), salad ~70% of its bowl (~124 cm²), fruit ~40% of its bowl (~71 cm²), dressing cup ~1 cm².

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Lasagna 60 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 180 ml; tortellini 94 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 188 ml; beef 63 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 63 ml; salad 124 cm² × 4 cm ≈ 496 ml; fruit 71 cm² × 4 cm ≈ 283 ml; dressing ~10 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Lasagna 180 × 0.9 ≈ 162 g; tortellini 188 × 0.8 ≈ 150 g; beef 63 × 0.95 ≈ 60 g; salad 496 × 0.15 ≈ 80 g; fruit 283 × 0.6 ≈ 170 g; dressing ≈ 10 g. Drinks: orange juice ≈ 200 g, iced coffee ≈ 250 g, water ≈ 200 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Lasagna 162 g × 150 kcal/100 g ≈ 243 kcal; tortellini 150 g × 170 ≈ 255 kcal; beef 60 g × 200 ≈ 120 kcal; salad 80 g × 20 ≈ 16 kcal; fruit 170 g × 50 ≈ 85 kcal; dressing 10 g × 80 ≈ 8 kcal; orange juice 200 g × 45 ≈ 90 kcal; iced coffee 250 g × 60 ≈ 150 kcal; water 0 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The food alone is about 630 g and about 730 kcal, which is plausible for a full pasta-and-meat tray. With drinks the total is about 1,080 g and about 970 kcal, though the drink volumes are rough guesses.
